narrative.overview: Behind one studio door, ten rooms — each built for the business that lives in it. The binding craft is that every room is a committed world with its own material, geometry, and physics, while the machinery underneath (routing, forms, dialogs, the circle wipe) keeps working untouched. Shared machinery stays quiet: Warm Paper under Ink Black, one system sans body stack, hairline structure, the 1120px container, and exactly one theatrical moment — the 480ms circle wipe. Each business page re-skins every shared surface inside its own page stylesheet, scoped under body[data-slug]. Identity lives in geometry and motion as much as in color.
keyCharacteristics: Ten page worlds + one studio shell; each world owns palette, display face, radii, hover physics, and component skins
One active page stylesheet per route, loaded by swapping a single <link data-page-css>; sub pages inherit their parent world
Shell-class overrides are scoped body[data-slug="…"]; shared component markup and JS hooks never change
System font stacks only; the per-world display face is the personality knob
One theatrical moment: the circle wipe; each world gets one authored motion moment of its own

rules.name: The World-Scoped Rule
rules.body: A world restyles shared surfaces only through rules scoped body[data-slug="…"] in its own page stylesheet. The shared shell and component JS never change to serve a world.

rules.name: The Wipe-Pair Rule
rules.body: Every world ships a --wipe-a / --wipe-b pair — dark pole and accent pole of the circle wipe. Frozen in :root, byte-identical to the original set.

rules.name: The Display-Swap Rule
rules.body: --font-display is the per-world personality knob; --font-body is never overridden. One body, many faces.

rules.name: The 1120 Rule
rules.body: Content lives inside min(100% - 2.5rem, 1120px); full-bleed is for bands and dividers.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth appears only as response — in the physics the world has chosen.

rules.name: The Owned-Geometry Rule
rules.body: Radius and border language belong to the world. Do not import another world's silhouette.

rules.name: The One Circle, One Play Rule
rules.body: The circle wipe is the page transition. Never add a second spectacle beside it.

rules.name: The Hooks-Fixed Rule
rules.body: Worlds re-skin; they never rename DOM hooks or edit shared JS.

dos: **Do** express a world through its page stylesheet scoped body[data-slug="…"], keeping the :root token block byte-identical.
**Do** re-skin every shared surface a page actually renders — nav, buttons, cards, FAQ, form, footer, more-pages, modal, lightbox, toasts, booking.
**Do** keep content inside min(100% - 2.5rem, 1120px) and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
**Do** theme browser surfaces per world: ::selection, focus-visible, ::placeholder, caret-color, scrollbar.
**Do** keep one authored motion moment per world and make the rest utilitarian.
**Do** give every literal in a world a home in the DESIGN.md colors, type ramp, or radius scale — or record it as content.
donts: **Don't** edit app.css, src/components/**, or public/assets/js/** to serve a world.
**Don't** let one world's motif leak into another (dotted leaders, corner ticks, gold double rules, dashes/stamps, tick rulers, rebate strips, dimension lines each belong to exactly one world).
**Don't** add webfonts or a font CDN; the system runs on local/system families only.
**Don't** add a second page-transition spectacle — one circle, one play.
**Don't** use bounce or elastic easing; real objects decelerate smoothly.
**Don't** drop body text contrast below 4.5:1 or use accents as small text on their own paper.
